caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic mug, which appears to be rendered in shades of grey, suggesting it is made from a reflective material such as pewter or steel. The mug is cylindrical with a wide base that tapers slightly as it moves upward, and it features two horizontal ridges encircling the upper portion and another set around the base. The handle is large, rounded, and attached at two points along the side of the mug. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of an off-white or light beige surface with no other objects or patterns present. The object is centered and isolated on the page, with the artist’s signature, “Leo Drozdoff,” in the bottom left corner.
title: Silver Mug
